source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "74th Amendment" OR "urban local bodies" OR "municipal corporation" OR "city government"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"74th Amendment" OR "urban local bodies" OR "municipal corporation" OR "city government",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("74th Amendment" OR "city government" OR "municipal corporation" OR "urban local bodies")
